items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: Actually, the first time I worked with Louis... they made sure that they had me playing in the band out there when Louis was there

ctx.x: He had, Fletcher Henderson had those big bands at the time. One of the first black bands that ever played together written arrangements and he had some fine people. He had Coleman Hawkins and Louis Armstrong and all those people playing, you know? And everybody knew Louis, but I'd never worked with him.

Actually, the first time I worked with Louis, I had the misfortune to have to lay off and so he came in town with a -- and brought some of his arrangements with him from back East and he had some tunes in there like "High Society," that had famous clarinet solos in it and there's nobody around town that could play the clarinet solos to "High Society." So, they made sure that they had me playing in the band out there when Louis was there, so I could play all the clarinet parts.
